periodicTask.bindingDescription: This drawer edits the delivery scope of a task definition. Keep the unified scope model, but complete platform governance, tenant execution range, and explicit tenant coverage in one place.

periodicTask.bindingTenantHelpGlobal: This mode does not require an explicit tenant list. Coverage is defined directly by the selected scope.

taskDescriptions.ai_provider_health_check: Checks the availability of all enabled AI providers every 5 minutes and writes the result to Redis for failover.
taskDescriptions.clean_expired_captchas: Cleans expired captcha cache entries every hour.
taskDescriptions.system_health_check: Checks overall system health every 5 minutes, including database and Redis connectivity.
taskDescriptions.reset_agent_daily_quotas: Resets daily agent quotas at midnight and cleans Redis keys without TTL.
taskDescriptions.reset_agent_daily_stats: Resets daily agent statistics at midnight by clearing the current-day Redis counters.
taskDescriptions.check_plugin_trial_expirations: Checks plugin trial expirations at 02:00 daily, disables expired plugins automatically, and sends warnings.
taskDescriptions.clean_expired_task_logs: Cleans task run records that are older than the retention window at 04:00 daily.
taskDescriptions.clean_expired_session_memories: Performs a 24-hour fallback cleanup for stale session-memory Redis keys at 03:30 daily.
taskDescriptions.sync_litellm_registry: Syncs LiteLLM and LLMRing multi-source model registry data to Redis at 04:00 daily for remote model creation defaults.
taskDescriptions.cleanup_recycle_bin: Physically deletes recycle-bin records older than 30 days at 03:00 daily.
taskDescriptions.task_check_ssl_renewals: Checks expiring SSL certificates at 03:00 daily, triggers platform renewals automatically, and warns about custom certificates nearing expiry.
taskDescriptions.cleanup_chunk_uploads: Cleans chunk-upload temporary files that exceed the retention window every 6 hours.
taskDescriptions.cleanup_expired_notifications: Cleans expired notifications at 03:00 daily according to the notification_retention_days setting.
